text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, my Princess! Mmm-mm... 
Shining!! You're polished to perfection, 
sparkling just like a jewel!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami, is there anything you want for a 
present? No need to hold back, just name 
it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Anything!? Even if you ask so suddenly, 
all I can think of is the Pre-Fi 
transformation compact...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The Magical Combo Wand and the talking 
Sebas plushie are both too good to pass 
up!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's it! Would you like to play with 
me? Let's play Pretend PreFighter!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Playing PreFighters...? What am I supposed 
to do?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I want to do an episode where we defeat an 
evil executive plotting to destroy the 
world's oceans after a desperate battle!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
With you, Pearl-san, I feel like we could 
perfectly recreate that hype episode!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Understood, I'll play the villain to 
absolute perfection.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah! It is simply the beeeest! !

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Then behold and receive... my "Princess 
Rolling Scarf Hold Fall"!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's a great name for a move! But no 
problem, I'll take it head-on with 
everything I've got!
